title: Istio限流故障：gRPC服务慢于代理超时导致失败关闭
body:
## 操作任务
实现task.py的repair(config)，仅将题目私有Envoy全局限流过滤器超时从0.05秒调整到批准的0.5秒，返回深拷贝并保持failure_mode_deny、domain、描述符、端点和其他字段。受控gRPC服务实际响应约0.18秒且返回允许；调整前代理因超时失败关闭，调整后两个代理各自请求成功，健康路径始终可用。

## 产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际Envoy、可达但受控延迟的私有gRPC服务和独立上游。

## 能力边界
仅验证自有user/net namespace与loopback下的受控时延及批准配置；无真实Istio控制面、生产流量、上游负载容量或业务SLO证明。失败关闭保持，延长预算不能代替排查服务性能或证明生产系统恢复。
answer: 核对限流服务连接成功但响应延迟超过代理超时，在批准预算内调整超时并保留失败关闭，再观察业务和健康路径。
explanation: 端点可达与规定时间内完成gRPC响应不同；调整超时会改变等待预算，必须评估整体延迟及服务容量。
rubric: 实际gRPC请求已到达但超时，修复只调整批准预算、失败关闭保持，两个代理恢复且健康路径不依赖限流服务。
review_note: 原模块故障场景真实缺口，新增题号绑定冻结空名额；不计原214故障和旧题改编。

exercise.environment: 私有WSL普通student；实际Envoy、私有grpcio和自有user/net namespace
exercise.operation: 核对限流服务超时并仅调整批准的代理预算。
exercise.validation_scope: 仅验证自有user/net namespace与loopback下的受控时延及批准配置；无真实Istio控制面、生产流量、上游负载容量或业务SLO证明。失败关闭保持，延长预算不能代替排查服务性能或证明生产系统恢复。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
assert os.getuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
before=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net');p=subprocess.run(['unshare','-Urn','--',sys.executable,'-B','checks/rls_worker.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=35)
print(p.stdout,flush=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr;assert os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net')==before
assert 'NATIVE_ENVOY_RLS_SLOW_RESPONSE_ACCEPTED_AFTER_APPROVED_TIMEOUT_FAIL_CLOSED_PRESERVED' in p.stdout
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
test_files.checks/rls_worker.py:
import copy,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,threading,time
from concurrent import futures
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'),'/tmp/opsforge-private-grpcio-1.76.0-20261028']
import grpc,task
from envoy_fixture import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm
assert os.getuid()==0
subprocess.run(['ip','link','set','lo','up'],check=True,capture_output=True)
def fields(raw):
 i=0;out={}
 while i<len(raw):
  key=raw[i];i+=1;number=key>>3;wire=key&7;assert wire==2
  n=0;shift=0
  while True:
   x=raw[i];i+=1;n|=(x&127)<<shift;shift+=7
   if x<128:break
  assert i+n<=len(raw);out.setdefault(number,[]).append(raw[i:i+n]);i+=n
 return out
lock=threading.Lock();events=[];counts={}
def decide(raw,context):
 message=fields(raw);domain=message[1][0].decode()
 with lock:events.append(domain)
 time.sleep(.18)
 return bytes([8,1])

server=grpc.server(futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2));server.add_generic_rpc_handlers((grpc.method_handlers_generic_handler('envoy.service.ratelimit.v3.RateLimitService',{'ShouldRateLimit':grpc.unary_unary_rpc_method_handler(decide,request_deserializer=lambda b:b,response_serializer=lambda b:b)}),));port=server.add_insecure_port('127.0.0.1:0');server.start()
try:
 with Upstream() as upstream:
  config=bootstrap(upstream.port);config['static_resources']['clusters'].append({'name':'rls','connect_timeout':'1s','type':'STATIC','http2_protocol_options':{},'load_assignment':{'cluster_name':'rls','endpoints':[{'lb_endpoints':[{'endpoint':{'address':{'socket_address':{'address':'127.0.0.1','port_value':port}}}}]}]}})
  manager=hcm(config);ordinary={'match':{'prefix':'/'},'route':{'cluster':'service','timeout':'1s','rate_limits':[{'actions':[{'generic_key':{'descriptor_value':'approved'}}]}]}};health={'match':{'path':'/health'},'route':{'cluster':'service','timeout':'1s'}};manager['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes']=[health,ordinary]
  manager['http_filters'].insert(0,{'name':'envoy.filters.http.ratelimit','typed_config':{'@type':'type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.ratelimit.v3.RateLimit','domain':'training','failure_mode_deny':True,'timeout':'0.05s','rate_limit_service':{'grpc_service':{'envoy_grpc':{'cluster_name':'rls'}},'transport_api_version':'V3'}}})
  original=copy.deepcopy(config)
  with Envoy(config) as before:
   assert before.request('/health')[0]==200
   failed=before.request('/api/slow')[0];assert failed>=500,failed
  assert events==['training'] and len(upstream.requests)==1
  time.sleep(.25)
  print('NATIVE_ENVOY_RLS_REACHABLE_BUT_SLOW_TIMEOUT_FAIL_CLOSED_HEALTH_AVAILABLE',flush=True)
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:adjust_only_approved_rls_timeout',flush=True)
  try:fixed=task.repair(config)
  except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('approved timeout repair failed') from error
  expected=copy.deepcopy(original);hcm(expected)['http_filters'][0]['typed_config']['timeout']='0.5s'
  assert config==original and fixed==expected,'only approved timeout may change'
  with Envoy(fixed) as first,Envoy(fixed) as second:
   n=len(events);assert first.request('/health')[0]==200 and len(events)==n
   started=time.monotonic();statuses=[first.request('/api/a')[0],second.request('/api/b')[0]];elapsed=time.monotonic()-started
   assert statuses==[200,200] and elapsed>=.30,(statuses,elapsed)
  assert events==['training','training','training'] and len(upstream.requests)==4
  print('NATIVE_ENVOY_RLS_SLOW_RESPONSE_ACCEPTED_AFTER_APPROVED_TIMEOUT_FAIL_CLOSED_PRESERVED',flush=True)

finally:server.stop(0).wait()
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
